canonical.title: Splitters and dockable panes in React (2026): which libraries to adopt

siblings.title: Resizable split panes in React (2026): react-resizable-panels vs Allotment
siblings.summary: react-resizable-panels is the default pick for app-shell splits; reach for Allotment only when you want VS Code look-and-feel with snapping out of the box.

siblings.title: Draggable VS Code-style panes in React: Dockview vs rc-dock vs FlexLayout vs react-mosaic (2026)
siblings.summary: Yes: Dockview is the default modern pick for VS Code-style pane docking in React; three real alternatives fit narrower cases.

siblings.title: Persisting and restoring pane layouts in React (2026)
siblings.summary: How react-resizable-panels, Allotment, Dockview, rc-dock and FlexLayout serialize and restore layouts, where to persist them, and how to survive a saved layout that references a deleted panel.

siblings.title: Hosting grids and forms inside resizable/dockable panes in React: the integration problems
siblings.summary: Per-library patterns and pitfalls for putting AG Grid / TanStack Table and forms inside resizable and dockable panes without layout thrash or lost state.
